## What changed since `fork-2026.09.24-0838c25`

- **`zedcli api list` / `envs` / `send`.** The API Client's saved requests and
  environments from the shell; `send` runs a saved request exactly as its Send
  button does — scripts, variables (`--var` overrides one), secrets masked in
  the output — and prints the body, with `--include` for the status and
  headers.
- Covered end to end against a real editor.
